description: One row of the one table that contact.search searches, by public key (key): {ok, key, person: {publicKey, publicLabel, caption, myLabel, keep, mine, relay, blocked, seated, present, url, bytesHeld, ambiguous?}}; for a relay's row also relay (the relay's row as the node holds it: its connection, owned, claimed, services, owner label, face) and report (that relay's last stream report, or null); 400 without a key, 404 when there is none.
